result.instructions: Author the bound cwd project. Start with project_overview; if project_not_initialized call project_init. Complete project_setup before writing. No provider configuration or generation tools are needed: render_prompt returns catalog prompts for YOU to execute. Submit results with the returned target UUID and expected_revision; reread on conflict. Ratio mismatch is advisory; keep is the default, crop/pad are optional. Lists are paginated. Never edit project.sqlite directly.

result.instructions: Author the bound cwd project. Start with project_overview; if project_not_initialized call project_init. Complete project_setup before writing. No provider configuration or generation tools are needed: render_prompt returns catalog prompts for YOU to execute. Submit results with the returned target UUID and expected_revision; reread on conflict. For batch settings render_prompt target=setting_board, generate the returned generation_prompt, immediately setting_boards import, then read_image and render_prompt target=setting_breakdown before apply_setting_breakdown. For single artwork call image_target before host generation; read_image supplies project references in the conversation. Immediately import_image using the actual file path from the host result (possibly output hint text); never assume savedPath, guess names or scan directories. Host image retention is unknown. Ratio mismatch is advisory; keep is the default, crop/pad are optional. Lists are paginated. Never edit project.sqlite directly.

Replay exactly the same request/key to recover; reread after conflict. Returns immutable output UUIDs, not a new generation.
